target: true-negative: a compliant summary must produce no warning, or the check is just noise on every call
cmd: jq -n "{worker:\"placeholder\",status:\"ok\",summary:\"a terse digest\",result:\"r\",artifacts:[],key_decisions:[],caveats:[],assumptions:[],confidence_ordinal:\"high\",usage:{}}" > env.json; jq -n --arg c "$(jq -c . env.json)" "{choices:[{message:{content:\$c}}],usage:{prompt_tokens:1,completion_tokens:1,cost:0}}" > mock.json; printf %s "{\"objective\":\"x\"}" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE=$PWD/mock.json bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter 2>err >/dev/null; if grep -qi 'summary is' err; then echo WARNED_WRONGLY; else echo SILENT; fi
